title: Healthy Norwegian Lamb Kebabs
description: A kid-friendly Norwegian dish featuring lamb shanks, this recipe is a fresh and silky take on traditional kebabs, with an ayurvedic sattvic-friendly twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the kebabs in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through.
While the kebabs are baking, heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Remove the kebabs from the oven and carefully place them in the skillet.
Cook the kebabs for an additional 2-3 minutes on each side, or until nicely browned.
